thread:
sasha: heads up — tenant-77 reporting intermittent 500s on dedicated eu cluster. sample customer req-id: req_20260317_9f3b2c. ~10% of requests failing in last 45m. they say timeout then 500. need repro bundle + node/gpu logs to correlate. can someone pick this up? :frowning:

maria: ok — do we have a curl repro with an explicit x-request-id? ask them to re-run with a reproducible header so we can map logs. also need pod name + node name from them.

sasha: they gave an obfuscated curl (auth removed). here is what they ran:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"<long prompt>"}' https://dedicated-eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --verbose
```

lucas: ask them to re-run with a custom header we can grep for. suggest: 
```
curl -i \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \ 
  -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-tenant77-01' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d @payload.json \ 
  'https://dedicated-eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \ 
  --write-out '%{http_code}\n' -v
```

maria: infra checklist for someone on the cluster: get pod + node, pull runtime logs and recent kubelet/journal entries. quick commands: 
```
kubectl -n dedicated get pods -o wide | grep tenant-77
kubectl -n dedicated logs <pod> -c runtime --since=2h > /tmp/<pod>-runtime.log
kubectl -n dedicated describe pod <pod> > /tmp/<pod>-describe.txt
```

kevin-oncall: I'll collect node-level and GPU telemetry. on the node (run as root):
```
sudo journalctl -u kubelet --since "2 hours" > /tmp/kubelet.log
sudo dmesg -T | egrep -i 'NVRM|Xid|GPU|OOM' > /tmp/dmesg-gpu.log
sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.used,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 5 -f /tmp/gpu-sample.csv &
sleep 60; pkill -f nvidia-smi
sudo cp /var/log/syslog /tmp/syslog || true
```
also capture /var/log/kern.log or /var/log/messages depending on distro. if we see Xid errors or NVRM messages include them.

sasha: can we get a lightweight customer repro while we collect logs? ask them to run: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \ 
  -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-tenant77-01' \ 
  -d @small.json \ 
  'https://dedicated-eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \ 
  --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -v
```
and paste the full response headers + body.

support-bot: Created support bundle 3245678901 at /var/tmp/support-bundles/3245678901.tar.gz (expires in 24h). Upload URL: https://s3.redwood.example/support/tenant-77/3245678901.tar.gz?sig=abc123

kevin-oncall: collected pod logs, node journal, dmesg, gpu-sample.csv and packaged. uploaded to the S3 link above. path: s3://support/tenant-77/3245678901.tar.gz

maria: next steps: grep the runtime logs for repro headers (X-Request-ID and original req_20260317_9f3b2c), correlate with trace/span ids in tracing system, and search dmesg for kernel/GPU errors. if we see NVML/Xid entries, escalate to eng-runtime. tagging @lucas for kernel/GPU stack check.

lucas: will pull bundle and do quick scan for 'repro-tenant77-01' and 'req_20260317_9f3b2c' and nvml/nvrm lines. will echo findings here.

sasha: update — customer re-ran with the repro header. we observe identical 500 and returned request-id repro-tenant77-01 at 16:12UTC. logs included in the bundle. leaving with kevin+maria+luca to triage. :thumbsup:
